name: Vala Mal Doran
Subtitle: High Stakes Gambler
Text: Each time Vala Mal Doran earns a glyph, for each glyph she has, you may reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a villain card, discard it and gain 1 power. If it's a hero card, take it into hand and your opponent draws a card.
Fancy Text: Each time Vala Mal Doran earns a glyph, for each glyph she has, you may reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a villain card, discard it and gain 1 power. If it's a hero card, take it into hand and your opponent draws a card.

name: Wotan
Subtitle: Archon of the High Council
Text:
When you play Wotan, you may search your deck for an Asgard card, reveal it, take it into hand, and shuffle your deck.
Stop Wotan - Gain 1 power.
Fancy Text:

name: Wraith Primary
Subtitle: Queen of Queens
Text: Each time you assign Wraith Primary, your opponent may drain 2 (they put the top two cards of their deck into their discard pile). If they don't, gain 2 power.
Fancy Text: Each time you assign Wraith Primary, your opponent may [b]drain 2[/b] [i](they put the top two cards of their deck into their discard pile)[/i]. If they don't, gain 2 power.

name: Zukhov
Subtitle: Resolute Team Leader
Text:
Each time a Russian support character is destroyed, draw a card.
libra or triangulum: Zukhov gets skills +1 for each Russian support character that was destroyed this turn.
Fancy Text:
Each time a Russian support character is destroyed, draw a card.
